precedence.base: Current house-contrast sharedLighting inherited exactly; Bible defines realism. Weather/time endpoint overrides only specified fields. No duplicate EV, wet darkening, AO or fog.
precedence.bibleEarlierLightingDifference: Bible embeds an earlier sharedLighting snapshot; current house-contrast hero object is base per user brief. No earlier warm grade reintroduced.

inheritedLakeWinterWater.wavePolicy: Amplitude is half peak-to-trough height. Profiles are look fixtures, not wave forecasts. Actual wind direction, duration, fetch, depth and observed waves override. Wind0 fixture has no leftover swell; live state can retain swell history.

shoreline.application: Water-side band only. Smoothstep from shore inward: shade multiplier=0.88+0.12*smoothstep(0,0.60,distanceToShore). Independent shore geometry remains fixed. Shallow-colour weight=1-smoothstep(0,shallowBlendWidthM,distanceToShore). No extra land darkening.
shoreline.edge: Separate 0.40m material transition into existing wet bank, clipped to mapped terrain intersection. No black border, alpha water overlay or shoreline relocation.

reflection.policy: These stylized blend coefficients are not measured Fresnel. No white brightness floor at night. Reuse sky environment; no planar mirrors, SSR, extra captures or per-ripple lights.

haze.policy: One shared weather haze term. Longer sight lines get more haze naturally; no separate lake fog multiplier. Live fog overrides fixture.

lod.farPolicy: Fade subpixel normals, retain mean roughness and broad reflected sky. Never enlarge world-space wavelengths to force visibility. Wind0 means no wave oscillation.

seawall.detail: large structural edges; no dense concrete noise

verifiedMechanisms: water absorption changes spectrum with path length
dissolved organic matter and suspended sediment/algae change colour
sky/reflected sun affect surface appearance, viewing angle changes their weight
colourModel.proposal: C_body=mix(C_deep,C_bottomContribution, exp(-K_water*depth)); only if depth and attenuation supported; otherwise profile shallow band flagged inferred. Add broad environment reflection once using view normal and roughness. K_water is water-column absorption/turbidity, NOT a second atmospheric fog. Do not bake sun colour or sky gradient into albedo and add it again. No exact sediment-to-hex calibration claimed.
colourModel.sunAngle: use actual sun vector; broken glint aligned with view/sun, no sun-following solid stripe; low sun increases path/glint geometry, not automatic orange base water
colourModel.sediment: independent supported turbidity/runoff input; rain code alone does not turn every river brown
colourModel.sandbar: requires shallow/bottom mask; illustrated Miami bank is inferred, not live bathymetry

waveModelProposal.windConvention: source direction is FROM clockwise true north; propagation TO=(FROM+180) mod 360; wave MWD uses same from convention; current directions parsed separately by source metadata
inputPriority: representative quality-controlled Hs/period/direction observation or forecast for correct time
supported wave model with spatial mapping
waveModelProposal.fallbackFormula: Hs_visual=min(profileCap,0.20*U^2/9.81 * sqrt(min(1,F/max(1,100*U^2))) * min(1,D/7200)); U>=0 m/s, F>=0 metres, D>=0 seconds
waveModelProposal.formulaStatus: authored fetch/duration limiter, NOT a calibrated wave forecast; missing fetch/duration use explicit profile fixture, never observed label
waveModelProposal.filter: U_smooth approaches U with 120 s time constant; Hs/period blend over 180 s, valid swell retained; raw events/alerts preserved independently
waveModelProposal.period: use representative measured DPD when available; fallback T=clamp(0.8+0.20*U,1,5) seconds for open water, 0.6–1.8 s for canals/river; authored bounds
waveModelProposal.dispersion: omega=2*pi/T; solve omega^2=g*k*tanh(k*h) when depth h known. Deep approximation lambda=g*T^2/(2*pi) only for deep regime; unknown depth uses artistic lambda bounded to mesh, labelled inferred. No current Doppler solver v1.
waveModelProposal.amplitudeFormula: Ai=(Hs_visual/4)*sqrt(2)*wi/sqrt(sum(wj^2)); sine variance then gives Hs=4*sqrt(sum(Ai^2)/2). This is spectral significant-height normalization, not Hs as one wave crest amplitude.
waveModelProposal.heightFormula: eta(x,t)=sum(Ai*sin(ki*dot(di,x)-omega_i*t+phi_i)); deterministic phases per stable water-body ID; normal from analytic gradient
waveModelProposal.mesh: only geometry wavelengths >=4 vertex spacings; smaller waves normal-only, fade below 1.5 projected pixels; never enlarge waves to force visibility
waveModelProposal.fetch: compute upwind open-water ray clipped to shoreline/banks, with shelter mask; world polygons fixed; fetch source-derived if available otherwise inferred
waveModelProposal.duration: retain wind-vector history; reset/reduce effective duration after large bearing change; unknown history means unknown duration
waveModelProposal.wakes: separate supported moving vessel track or explicitly simulated wake source; seeded finite ribbon, amplitudes .02–.15 m authored, decay 10–45 s; clip to water, no fake live boats
waveModelProposal.iceDamping: Ai*=1-iceCoverageLocal; stationary shelf has no oscillation; broken floes stretch, not rigid full-lake sheet

foamRulesProposal.activation: crest steepness/observed breaking plus edge interaction; wind condition alone insufficient; use smoothstep(.10,.16,localHeightOverWavelength) as art-only crest cue
foamRulesProposal.shoreFoam: signed shore distance mask, phase-broken irregular segments; exclude vertical shoreline blanket stripe; beach breaker from shallow supported/inferred band
foamRulesProposal.shelf: do not confuse white foam with stationary ice; foam disappears/advects, ice persists by history
foamRulesProposal.performance: material mask in same water draw, sparse optional short splash pool <=64 near-camera particles; no all-surface white noise

styleCoefficientsInherited.policy: These stylized blend coefficients are not measured Fresnel. No white brightness floor at night. Reuse sky environment; no planar mirrors, SSR, extra captures or per-ripple lights.

reflectionLimits.baseline: reuse inherited stylized normal/grazing coefficients, not additive to a second PBR lobe; one chosen shading path
reflectionLimits.limiter: R= min(capByTier, inheritedNormal+(inheritedGrazing-inheritedNormal)*(1-dot(N,V))^5); replace inherited aerial multiplier with tier cap, do not apply both
reflectionLimits.environment: reuse coarse shared prefiltered sky; optional broad building reflection masks under river/piers, no sharp duplicate facades
reflectionLimits.glint: sparse restrained broad sun highlight, no emissive white floor, no mirror at night

atmosphereAndExposure.formula: T=exp(-integral(sigma_air ds)); homogeneous simplification exp(-sigma_air*cameraDistance); L_after=T*L_water+(1-T)*L_air; one shared extinction integration for water and other geometry
atmosphereAndExposure.ownership: renderer selects material or shared post owner, never both. Layered SF marine fog integrates one spatial sigma field, no extra bay haze overlay.
atmosphereAndExposure.exposure: apply shared weather/time exposure once after shading and atmospheric integration; no second EV in water material, no duplicated warmth, contrast or saturation
atmosphereAndExposure.wetShore: reuse inherited water-side .6 m darkening band max12%; one land wetness owner, never stack shoreline and rain multipliers
atmosphereAndExposure.night: actual low-light environment, no minimum water luminance; warm reflections limited to eligible supported lights

iceRules.default: coverage unknown/null until supported; illustration ice is conditional demo, never observation
iceRules.enable: fresh spatial ice observation/model plus complete cold/water-temperature history where available; for unsurveyed local shelves require supported local evidence or explicit inferred/demo mode. Air below zero or falling snow alone insufficient.
iceRules.history: retain hourly thermal context and daily GLERL concentrations for Lake Michigan; no universal FDD-to-shelf geometry conversion
iceRules.coverage: use spatial source concentration, not lake-wide percentage spread uniformly; coarse cells cannot establish a specific seawall shelf
iceRules.waterTemperature: surface water evidence constrains plausibility; saline freeze threshold depends on salinity, do not use freshwater rule in sea/harbour
iceRules.fallback: missing history remains unknown, default visible open water with unknown label; last supported ice can persist marked stale, not silently melt by month
iceRules.shelves: stationary opaque matte fragmented nearshore geometry, .2–1 m visual thickness only if supported/inferred; no claim of real ice thickness or safe access
iceRules.snowOnIce: separate supported snow reservoir; snow never creates ice
iceRules.geometryBudget: <=2000 triangles included in water envelope; far area mask, no moving shelf/wave double layer
iceRules.melt: observed/history-backed gradual coverage update over hours/days; do not melt during a UI condition switch

livePolicy.selection: same water basin, shelter and exposure; nearest buoy is not automatically representative; never extrapolate ocean waves into canals or Sloan lake
livePolicy.cacheProposal: server cache per station/product/water body; observations request 15 min, daily ice request 6 h, forecasts per issuer cadence; respect source cache headers and limits, coalesce requests; refresh never faster merely because camera moves
livePolicy.expiryProposal: station observation >2 h stale, daily ice >36 h stale, forecast outside valid interval stale; adapter may shorten based on product metadata; these thresholds authored
livePolicy.cost: documented public feeds avoid subscription charge, but bandwidth/compute/storage not free; NDBC current route not endpoint-tested
livePolicy.tide: use source UTC, metric units and named vertical datum; tie level to world datum once; unknown datum means no absolute vertical motion; tide prediction labelled forecast, observation labelled observed
livePolicy.localLevel: Great Lakes water-level observations/seiche context; no ocean tide copied into Chicago River/Sloan; Dutch managed canal levels require local source, not nearby sea tides
livePolicy.recap: store raw support/provenance plus final fractions, phases/modelVersion and datum; replay timestamp deterministically; distinguish later archive lookup from recorded observation

performanceProposal.status: allocation target carved out of scene allowance; unbenchmarked A16/phone, not a measured pass
performanceProposal.near: up to4 geometric sine terms +2 normal terms; shared material, clipped opaque surface, no refractive screen copy
performanceProposal.aerial: 2 terms, coarser mesh, foam mask only; same water colours and wind inputs
performanceProposal.far: flat mesh, mean roughness/body colour, no normals or wakes; preserve real extent and shared extinction
performanceProposal.fillRate: water may cover most screen: opaque single pass, avoid stacked translucent sheets, FFT/SSR/reflection camera excluded from v1
performanceProposal.resources: one small authored mask atlas plus mesh; no remote photo texture; count actual allocations, mipmaps and transient targets in device validation
performanceProposal.precision: camera-relative vertex positions; evaluate phases from stable split world origin/modular tile offset to survive rebasing, not raw float planet coordinates
performanceProposal.reuse: same profile/seed/input schema in RealityKit Metal CustomMaterial and three.js adapter; no claim current repo supports all hooks

waterRulePrecedence.active: waveModelProposal and reflectionLimits control this pack; inheritedLakeWinterWater wind tables are retained historical fixtures, not a second active wave system. Current sharedLighting controls the sun, overriding historical water fixture sun angles.
waterRulePrecedence.reflection: Choose the capped art environment blend OR renderer PBR response, never add both. Do not also multiply inherited aerialScale after applying aerial cap.
waterRulePrecedence.ice: iceRules supersedes any calendar/default ice inference; winter sheet art is conditional demo only.

screenDetailTiersProposal.near: shore blocks, piles and contact band only when >=4 projected pixels; normals fade below 1.5px wavelength
screenDetailTiersProposal.aerial: two geometric wave terms; simplified fixed shore silhouettes; broken foam survives only above 2px
screenDetailTiersProposal.far: flat mean surface, no per-wave or wake detail; shore becomes extent/colour band
screenDetailTiersProposal.transition: smoothstep across 20% projected-size overlap; retain mean water extent, no LOD wave-size inflation
screenDetailTiersProposal.status: proposal; measure actual phone shimmer and transition cost
